rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved or Kentucky Board of Pharmacy-approved CE, relevant to pharmacy practice; IPCE (joint accreditation) credit reported to CPE Monitor is accepted; individually obtained non-ACPE CE needs Board approval (application within 30 days)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pharmacists first licensed within the 12 months before the annual renewal date are exempt for that year.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: excess hours or units cannot be applied to future years.
rules.alternatives: Year-to-year deferral at the Board's discretion for illness, incapacity or other extenuating circumstances. CEU from another state transferable if that state recognizes Kentucky CEU.
rules.audit_note: Do not submit CE proof with the renewal; the Board audits through NABP CPE Monitor. Keep records 3 years.

topics.who: All pharmacists, licensing years 2023 through 2028: opioid epidemic or opioid use disorder (part of the 15 hours)

rules.notes: 15 contact hours (1.5 CEU) earned each year between March 1 and February 28, before renewal. Reporting: CE audits use NABP CPE Monitor data. Late renewal: 15 hours per missed year, max 75.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Complete a minimum of one and five-tenths (1.5) CEU (fifteen (15) contact hours) annually between March 1 and February 28 of the subsequent year prior to licensing renewal;
